fixed.summary: The safe-area insets now clear the host's covered region (Viewport.covered, a published page's Back): it is folded into the one edge whose inset clears it for the least surface, the left inset on a landscape or desktop surface and the top one on a portrait phone, so a HUD document placed at the insets never draws under Back. A change of the covered region re-resolves what reads them.

breaking.member: og.ui.anchor, og.ui.openAnchor, og.ui.label, og.ui.close, og.ui.AnchorDesc, og.ui.LabelDesc, og.ui.Response, og.ui.UiBuild, og.ui.Size, og.ui.Direction, og.ui.Align, og.ui.Cross, og.ui.FontRole, og.ui.StylePart
breaking.change: The last immediate-mode UI builders and the types only they used are removed: a HUD group is a document now that its CSS insets clear the host's controls.
breaking.fix: Write the HUD as a component document mounted with og.ui.scope(world, id).mount(...) and its values in stores. Place each corner with `position: fixed` and insets read from env(): `left: calc(env(-og-hud-inset-left) + 24px); top: calc(env(-og-hud-inset-top) + 24px)` (right and bottom alike), which keep it clear of Back and inside the HUD band on an ultrawide; a label is a `<span>` styled with `font: var(--text-display-sm)`, `font-family: var(--font-mono)` and `color: var(--ink-muted)`, the group's look `background: var(--panel); border-radius: var(--radius-panel); -og-frame: card`.
